name: vscode-eslint
description: The web implementation of dbaeumer.vscode-eslint: lints JS/TS inside tsserver (reusing its typescript) and honors the same eslint.* settings, fix-all on save and formatter.

eslint.enable.description: Controls whether eslint is enabled or not.

eslint.validate.description: An array of language ids which should be validated by ESLint. In the browser, only JavaScript and TypeScript languages are linted.

eslint.rules.customizations.description: Override the severity of one or more rules reported by this extension, regardless of the project's ESLint config. Use globs to apply default severities for multiple rules.

eslint.workingDirectories.description: Specifies how the working directories ESLint is using are computed. In the browser the workspace root is always the working directory.
